A cottage interior looking into the canyon

notes: Robert Redford's resort in Provo Canyon, 5,000 acres under Mount Timpanogos, in the rustic-modern timber-and-stone idiom the place basically invented. Lodging is rooms, cottages/suites and multi-bedroom mountain homes; about 12,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor meeting space. Redford sold his stake in 2020 to a Broadreach/Cedar investor group. Rates are resort-priced: third-party listings for October 2026 show roughly $278-$482 a night depending on unit.
